description: Searches notes with Anki's native query syntax. In v1 mode, defaults to a native page with a continuation cursor. Request pagination: offset for an exact total or a numeric position.

cursor.description: Use the previous nextCursor with the same query and limit. Omit it on the first cursor page.

offset.description: Supplying an offset, even 0, selects offset mode unless pagination is explicit.

pagination.description: Defaults to cursor when v1 is enabled and no offset is supplied. Use offset for an exact total or a numeric position.

query.description: Native Anki search query, for example "deck:German tag:A1", "note:Basic", or "Front:*Hund*". An empty query searches all notes.

name: search-notes

nextCursor.description: Present in cursor mode. Null means the search is complete.

modifiedAt.description: Note modification time as an ISO 8601 timestamp

offset.description: Offset used in legacy mode; null in cursor mode.

total.description: Exact count in offset mode; null in cursor mode.

title: Search notes
